source_gate.purpose: Only determines whether to proceed to a separately frozen target test.

base: round32/features_labels frozen scorer, no continued scorer training
training: Complete source training rows only; retain original weights; no partial labels used to learn stopping boundary.
input: 35d: softmax-weighted33d anchor/context, normalized entropy, top2 logit gap. Train-only weighted mean/std.
initializer: Intercept=-1; feature coefficients=0. Train-only frozen normalization from round34.
loss: ATLOP virtual threshold two categorical terms, all observed positive/negative classes, fixed school logits.
primary: adaptive_head: mean per-seed school logit minus mean learned TH >0; no validation threshold fitting; empty falls back to argmax.
controls: Same source data, loss, ridge coefficient and solver for constant and linear heads; original relative-probability strong control retained.
source_gate_rule: Original single/multi/attainable gate AND balanced_exact >= both controls AND each stress exact >= both controls; only adaptive_head may advance.
checkpoint: Final training iterate only; no fit or early stopping on source validation or Shenzhen.
complete_population: Original1246source development validation; no target inference before pass. Later target trial must include all cumulative facts identically for controls.
head: adaptive_head is a LINEAR35d query function plus intercept; constant_head is intercept only.
hypothesis_change: Changes head class from nonlinear35->32->1 to linear35->1; not capacity matched. Does not alter or rescue round36.
optimizer: float64 full Newton analytic Hessian, Armijo1e-4 backtracking; at most100steps, at most60line-search halvings.
stopping: Training gradient infinity norm<=1e-6; no validation checkpoint selection.
regularization: 0.01*((intercept+1)^2+mean(feature_weights^2)); no feature term for constant head.
convergence_gate: All10linear adaptive heads must reach gradient_inf<=1e-6; source predictive gates unchanged.
research_basis: Reviewed ATLOP two categorical terms; affine threshold and strictly positive quadratic regularization make the objective strongly convex. Local probe, not ATLOP reproduction.
